question: On which island is India's only active volcano located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barren Island**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Barren Island** is home to the only active volcano in India, located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The volcano on Barren Island last erupted in **2017** and has a history of periodic eruptions, with the first recorded eruption dating back to 1787.
 
• The island is uninhabited due to its volcanic activity, and access is strictly regulated by the Indian government.
 
• The volcanic island is around **3 km in diameter** and mostly consists of barren, rugged terrain, hence its name.
 
• The volcano is classified as a **stratovolcano** and is part of the volcanic arc associated with the subduction zone of the Indo-Australian Plate beneath the Eurasian Plate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Minicoy Island**

 
 
• Minicoy is part of the Lakshadweep Islands and is known for its vibrant coral reefs and pristine beaches.
 
• It is the second-largest island in Lakshadweep and is renowned for its traditional "Dhoni" boat-making and tuna fishing industries.
 
• Minicoy is not home to any volcanoes, as it is a coral atoll and lacks volcanic origins.
 
 
 
• **Kavaratti Island**
 
 
• Kavaratti is the capital of Lakshadweep and is famous for its scenic beauty, marine biodiversity, and water sports activities.
 
• The island is a coral island and does not have any volcanic activity.
 
• It is a major tourist destination and serves as an administrative hub for the Lakshadweep group of islands.
 
 
 
• **Havelock Island**
 
 
• Havelock Island, now known as Swaraj Dweep, is part of the Andaman Islands and is a popular tourist destination.
 
• The island is famous for its white-sand beaches, clear waters, and vibrant coral reefs, with Radhanagar Beach being a major attraction.
 
• Unlike Barren Island, Havelock Island does not have any volcanic activity and is inhabited by local communities.
